name: AU 10Y Yield vs AUDNZD: Does the Rate Differential Drive the Cross?
description: Rolling 252-day Pearson correlation between Australian 10Y government bond yield (FRED: IRLTLT01AUM156N, monthly, forward-filled to daily) and AUDNZD spot rate. Charts: correlation time series with ±0.5 reference lines, AUDNZD price. Event markers on correlation crossing ±0.5 thresholds. Decade summary table (2000s, 2010s, 2020s) with mean/min/max correlation, avg yield, avg AUDNZD.
source:
# --- AU 10Y Yield vs AUDNZD: Rolling 252-Day Correlation ---
# Investigates whether Australian long-term rates drive the AUD/NZD cross rate.
# Monthly FRED yield data is forward-filled to daily for correlation computation.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
ts = index().value

# AUDNZD daily close
audnzd_close = src.c

# Australian 10Y yield (monthly, % units) → forward-fill to daily
au_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRLTLT01AUM156N")
au_10y = ffill(au_10y_raw.result)

# --- Rolling 252-Day Correlation ---
rolling_corr = corr(au_10y, audnzd_close, window=252)

# --- Decade Classification ---
# Extract year, map to decade bucket: 1=2000s, 2=2010s, 3=2020s
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts).value
decade_group = conditional_select(
    year_num >= 2000 and year_num <= 2009, 1.0,
    year_num >= 2010 and year_num <= 2019, 2.0,
    year_num >= 2020, 3.0,
    0.0 / 0.0
)

# Filter series by decade (only where correlation is valid)
corr_by_decade = where(is_valid(rolling_corr) and is_valid(decade_group), rolling_corr)
yield_by_decade = where(is_valid(rolling_corr) and is_valid(decade_group), au_10y)
audnzd_by_decade = where(is_valid(rolling_corr) and is_valid(decade_group), audnzd_close)
decade_key = where(is_valid(rolling_corr) and is_valid(decade_group), decade_group)

# --- Chart 1: Rolling 252-Day Correlation ---
xy_lines(
    title="How Correlated Are AU Rates and AUDNZD?",
    y_axis_label="252-Day Rolling Correlation",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    category="AU 10Y vs AUDNZD",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="252d Correlation", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title="+0.5 Strong Positive", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title="-0.5 Strong Negative", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.5, to=1.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.05),
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=-0.5, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05)
    ]),
    order=-2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rolling_corr)

# --- Chart 2: AUDNZD Close Price ---
xy_lines(
    title="AUDNZD Spot Rate",
    y_axis_label="AUDNZD",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    category="AU 10Y vs AUDNZD",
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="AUDNZD Close", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=-1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=audnzd_close)

# --- Event Markers: Correlation Threshold Crossings ---
# Crossing ABOVE +0.5
cross_above_pos = crossover(rolling_corr, 0.5)
# Crossing BELOW -0.5
cross_below_neg = crossunder(rolling_corr, -0.5)

# Strong Positive Correlation event
pos_label = "Strong Positive Correlation"
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Strong Positive Correlation",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Correlation", dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="AUDNZD", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="AU 10Y Yield (%)", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(pos_label, rolling_corr, audnzd_close, au_10y, cross_above_pos)

# Strong Negative Correlation event
neg_label = "Strong Negative Correlation"
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Strong Negative Correlation",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Correlation", dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="AUDNZD", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="AU 10Y Yield (%)", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(neg_label, rolling_corr, audnzd_close, au_10y, cross_below_neg)

# --- Decade Summary Table ---
# RowSpec mode: (values, groupKey) where groupKey = 1/2/3 for decades
# 5 metrics × 3 decades. Each metric needs its own table call in rowspec,
# but we can use standard mode with manual cells for full control.
# Using rowspec with 5 rows × 3 decade columns.
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category="AU 10Y vs AUDNZD",
    order=0,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Decade Breakdown: Correlation, Yield & AUDNZD",
        col_headers=["2000s", "2010s", "2020s"],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name="Mean 252d Correlation", agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            RowSpec(name="Min Correlation", agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            RowSpec(name="Max Correlation", agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(corr_by_decade, decade_key)

# Second table for yield and AUDNZD averages by decade
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category="AU 10Y vs AUDNZD",
    order=1,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Decade Averages: Yield & AUDNZD",
        col_headers=["2000s", "2010s", "2020s"],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name="Avg AU 10Y Yield (%)", agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name="Avg AUDNZD Close", agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(yield_by_decade, decade_key)
